_about: Prompts and settings for tools/generate_meshy.py. Edit prompts freely; delete a character to skip it. Animation action ids come from Meshy's animation library (see README).

defaults.style_suffix: full body, standing in A-pose, single character, original design, stylized-realistic game character, clean PBR textures, noir 1970s city, no text, no logos
